items.headline: College football Bottom 10 after Week 5: Michigan is back for more
items.description: Apparently the Wolverines were so comfortable on our dubious list last week, they decided to stick around.

items.headline: Nevada and UTEP meet in MWC play
items.description: Nevada (1-3) at UTEP (1-4), Oct. 10 at 7 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Toa Fa’avae's 3 TDs, New Mexico defense lead Lobos over UTEP 61-7
items.description: — Toa Fa’avae threw for 249 yards and three touchdowns as New Mexico routed UTEP 61-7 on Saturday in a Mountain West opener for both teams.

items.headline: College football Bottom 10 after Week 4: Time not on Michigan's side
items.description: After a controversial last-second win earlier in the season, the tables were turned on the Wolverines.

items.headline: New Mexico takes on UTEP in MWC play
items.description: UTEP (1-3) at New Mexico (3-1), Oct. 3 at 4 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Atkinson throws 3 TD passes in Oregon State's 33-7 win over UTEP
items.description: — Braden Atkinson threw three touchdown passes and AJ Newberry ran for 111 yards and a score to help Oregon State beat UTEP 33-7 on Saturday night.
